title: Register a small business (Udyam + GST + Shops)

nodes.title: Have Aadhaar
nodes.detail: Aadhaar number of proprietor/partner for OTP.

nodes.title: Have PAN
nodes.detail: PAN validated against Income Tax database.

nodes.title: Udyam Registration
nodes.detail: Free, paperless, self-declaration on udyamregistration.gov.in. Instant e-certificate with QR.

nodes.title: GST Registration
nodes.detail: On gst.gov.in with PAN + business address proof. GSTIN in ~7 working days.

nodes.title: Shops & Establishment
nodes.detail: State labour portal registration for physical premises.
